title: The player journey in the redesigned market style
problem: The screens around play (Home, menus, lobby, results, progress) do not carry the game's cards, characters and stalls, Play is split across menus, and Rematch is not prominent.
scope: Home: illustrated stall, one Play, Daily preview with the real first customer and lorry fruit, next unlock on the stall, two goals
Play menu: Quick match, Private room, code, Computer, One phone, public rooms, with real counts and lengths
Quick match wait: shopkeeper card, timer, a practice price on a real customer card, computer game option
Private room: code and share link, stalls as seats with Ready, empty seats offer a computer
Guided first sale for new players on the day-1 table
Results and Rematch: rank tiles, best sale on the real card, earned reward on your stall, stamps, large Rematch
Market League, Stamp Book and Wardrobe in the same art, with the next reward and the equipped item on your stall
exclusions: No rule, scoring, reward, length or mode changes
The gameplay screens (Buying, Stocking, Bell, Rush, Day Close) until the owner approves them

acceptance.text: npm run test:e2e: solo, quick match, private and public rooms, rematch; 0 leaks
Screens at 390, 360 and 320 for all nine screens and their main states

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-21: "implement page 6 from the mockup into the live game, approve", then "page 6, meaning the whole ui/ux journey across the rest of the journey you shared" (the nine screens of the v3 journey board)
